四级核心词汇 · 01英文原文

The Stop Beneath the Red Arrow

红箭头下的那一站 · 596 词 · 8 段 · 首次出现的目标词加粗

1At dawn a blast of thunder shook a rural valley. Rain still swept across the northern slope. A bus carrying pupils was bound for a science fair in the region. A violent surge had blocked the town's main avenue and disrupted transit. Nia, the driver, saw part of the concrete barrier above the drainage tunnel collapse. She stopped the vehicle, checked its tires, and alerted transit headquarters. Nobody knew whether the road underneath could absorb another impact.

2A local radio bulletin announced that buses should depart for a temporary terminal beyond the railroad platform and the old customs shed. The message caused chaos. Some passengers assumed the north entrance was open. Others remembered a hazardous fuel spill beside the freight lane. Nia stopped at the curb and asked them to await assistance. A portable torch helped her inspect the approach. Its beam caught a red arrow behind a pile of branches. It pointed away from the track, toward a farm road.

3An old sign declared the outer lane a flood zone. The current had ceased, but the surface was still slippery. A van had tried to turn and become trapped. The driver gripped a rope and waved a blanket. Nia dialed the emergency number. She used the arrow to orient the dispatcher, then asked the school principal to take the pupils to the upper deck of the station.

4An officer arrived from the northeast. He had anticipated a second burst of rain and brought a pump. A cable nearby had caught fire. His crew cut the supply and extinguished the flame. Spilled fuel could form an explosive mixture. A spark could trigger an explosion. He forbade anyone to mount the bank. Even a lane that appeared clear might present a hazard, so he ordered an urgent retreat to the station.

5Among Ren's possessions was a map from the bus terminal. It showed a trail along the southern boundary. Its altitude was several meters above the flooded road. Nia did not know whether it extended beyond the station wall. The officer sent a scout to verify the area. While they waited, Ren drew two arrows on a ticket. One showed where the scout would investigate. The other led to a shelter where volunteers had delivered blankets.

6The station's duty officer wanted to proceed with the transfer within minutes. A passenger began to scream when the van seemed to plunge deeper into the ditch. The driver's soaked blanket could no longer keep him warm. The peril was evident, even from a flight of stairs above the road. Nia asked the officer to wait for the scout and use that time to help the man.

7The pump lowered the water enough to haul the wreck onto dry ground. The driver began to tremble and could barely grasp the rope. A volunteer stayed beside him. The scout reported that a fallen trunk narrowed the path but left the final stretch intact. The pupils could transfer to another bus there. Nia asked the radio operator to repeat the notice concerning the new stop and name the red arrow as a landmark.

8By dusk the fair had commenced without them. Ren unfolded his map anyway. He had planned to demonstrate a device that detected moisture in soil. He could now explain another problem. A forecast had warned them about rain throughout the valley. Nevertheless, its foremost purpose was to warn. Directions came later. Ren drew the station, the broken barrier, and the route in order. He circled the stop where somebody had paused to check. That pause had prevented a second crash.

四级核心词汇 · 01中文译文

红箭头下的那一站

按英文段落顺序对照阅读

1天刚亮，一声炸雷震动了乡间的山谷。雨还在扫过北面的山坡。一辆巴士载着学生去参加本地区的科学展，汹涌的洪水却堵住了镇上的主干道，交通因此中断。司机妮娅看见排水隧道上方的混凝土护栏塌了一截。她停下车，检查轮胎，再通知公交调度中心。没人知道下方的路面还能不能承受一次冲击。

2当地电台发布简讯，说巴士应开往临时站，地点在铁路站台和旧海关棚屋的另一侧。这条消息让车里乱了起来。有人以为北入口开着，也有人记得货运车道旁有危险的燃油泄漏。妮娅在路边停好车，请大家等候协助。她拿着手电筒查看前面的路，光束照到一堆树枝后面的红箭头。箭头偏离铁轨，指向一条乡间小路。

3旧告示把外侧车道划成了易涝区。水流停了，路面仍很滑。一辆货车试图在那里转弯，结果被困住了。司机一手抓着绳子，一手挥动毯子。妮娅拨通紧急电话，用红箭头帮调度员确定位置，然后请校长把学生带到车站的上层。

4一名应急人员从东北方向赶来。他预料还会有一阵急雨，带了抽水泵。附近一条电缆着了火，队员切断电源，扑灭火苗。泄漏的燃油可能形成易爆混合物，一点火星就可能引发爆炸。他禁止任何人爬上路堤。看着畅通的车道也可能有危险，因此他让大家赶快退回车站。

5学生任带着一张从巴士站拿来的地图。图上有一条沿南侧边界的小路，海拔比被淹的道路高几米。妮娅不确定小路是否通到车站围墙外，应急人员就派人去察看。等候时，任在车票上画了两个箭头。一个指向要察看的小路，另一个指向临时避难点，志愿者已经把毯子送到了那里。

6车站值班人员想在几分钟内安排转乘。一位乘客看到货车似乎又往沟里滑了一截，忍不住叫了出来。司机的毯子湿透了，已经不能保暖。就算站在路上方的一段台阶上，也看得出他处境危险。妮娅请值班人员等察看的人回来，先利用这段时间帮货车司机。

7抽水泵把水位降下来，队员得以把受损的货车拖到干地。司机开始发抖，几乎抓不住绳子。一位志愿者留下来陪他。察看的人回来报告，一截倒下的树干挡住了部分小路，最后一段仍然通畅。学生可以从那里换乘另一辆巴士。妮娅请电台重新广播临时站的位置，把红箭头说成一个找得到的标志。

8到了黄昏，科学展已经开始了，学生们没赶上。任还是把地图摊开。他原本要展示一件测土壤水分的装置，现在却有了另一个能讲清楚的问题。天气预报提醒过大家，整个山谷都会下雨。那是一个预警，具体该走哪个入口还得后来查明。任依次画出车站、断裂的护栏和通行路线。他圈出大家停下来核查的地方。正是那次停顿，避免了第二起事故。
